_comment: Benchmark editions. An edition is one frozen setup - harness generation, OpenCode version, model roster, judge - and everything recorded in it is comparable; nothing is compared across editions. `current` is the edition new runs are written to and stamped with (meta.json versions.edition); its `results` directory is bench.RESULTS. An edition whose `results` is the bare `results` tree predates this file: its runs are told apart by their harness stamp, and the one with `harness: null` takes whatever no other edition claims (runs from before harness stamps existed), which stay browsable but are never ranked. `models` is the roster a current edition runs and shows before any result exists; a past edition shows the models it has runs for. Start a new edition, rather than editing one, whenever the harness, OpenCode, the model roster or the judge changes: see docs/editions.md.
